LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_RavenLiquidLakeShallow.des: A shallow lake of thick, milky raven fluid with a slowly undulating surface; wading into it noticeably slows movement.
LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_RavenLiquidLakeDeep.label: [Raven] Deep Raven Fluid Lake
LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_RavenLiquidLakeDeep.descri: Heavy raven fluid pools into a deep lake here, the surface gleaming softly while the depths glow with a dim milky white.
LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_RavenLiquidFertileSoil.des: Soil thoroughly saturated with concentrated raven fluid fertilizer, steadily releasing nutrients; its fertility is notably higher than ordinary rich soil.
LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_RavenLiquidContaminatedSoi: Ordinary soil permeated by raven fluid that still supports normal crop growth.
LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_RavenLiquidContaminatedFer: Nutrient-rich soil stained white by raven fluid that remains suitable for efficient farming.
LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_RavenLiquidContaminatedGra: Raven fluid has congealed between the stones, but the ground remains firm.
LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_RavenLiquidContaminatedMud: Thick raven fluid mixed into wet mud slows every step.
LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_RavenLiquidContaminatedSan: Dry sand saturated with raven fluid, its fine grains glinting unnaturally.
LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_RavenLiquidContaminatedSof: Soft sand holds raven fluid and gives way beneath every step.
LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_Tile.label: [Raven] Tile
LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_Tile.description: Tiles made of highly polished raven alloy. Their surface is extremely smooth, naturally stain-resistant, very easy to clean, and highly decorative.
